alternate_mechanisms.name: oath_becomes_prayer_and_answer
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Sustaining and sacred witnesses form a solemn address. Security becomes faith, formulaic assent becomes response, and the divine name closes in acknowledgment of perfect judgment. Amen-language remains an underlay, not recited text.

alternate_mechanisms.name: exception_logic_structures_moral_outcome
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The passage repeatedly partitions outcomes: believers who act soundly are excepted from descent, finitude and reproach are excluded from reward, and imperfect judgment is denied of God.

alternate_mechanisms.name: inner_form_confronts_the_deceptive_self
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Excellent form includes inward character and social agency. Denial can arise from a deceptive self that turns back from faith, so descent is also failure to realize the ethical interior of created conformation.

alternate_mechanisms.name: judgment_as_entrusted_verification
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The signs demand verification rather than denial. Deep judgment recognizes the evidence, conscience accepts responsibility, and final adjudication is entrusted to the Judge whose knowledge reaches truth.

alternate_mechanisms.name: reward_repairs_and_sustains_form
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Decline damages the originally sound form. Righteous action is reparative, reward carries a fracture-mending shadow, sustaining strength prevents collapse, and perfected judgment can turn the trajectory back toward order.

alternate_mechanisms.name: measured_economy_exceeded_by_grace
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Measured formation, wage-bearing work, recompense, debt, and reckoning evoke an account. Yet the reward is uncut, unreproached, and freely released, exceeding a closed commercial settlement.

alternate_mechanisms.name: embodied_dignity_anointed_not_consumed
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The olive's oil can nourish but also honor and care for the body. Anointing and perfumed treatment form a material dignity analogue for the excellently formed human, without asserting ritual application.

alternate_mechanisms.name: worn_appearance_versus_enduring_truth
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Form can wear down, visible appearance can deceive, and reversal can introduce defect. Sound deeds and undiminished sustaining reward distinguish enduring truth from a surface that misreports inward condition.
